import { Button, Cluster, Stack, Text } from "@hackcove/ui-react";

export const view = (items: string[]) => (
  <Stack gap="sm">
    <Cluster gap="xs">
      <Text as="span">In a row</Text>
    </Cluster>
    <Button>
      <Text as="span">In a button</Text>
    </Button>
    {items.map((item) => (
      <Text as="span" key={item}>
        {item}
      </Text>
    ))}
  </Stack>
);
